def fetch_received_requests(status):
    results = []
    page_limit = 20
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_access_token, status=status, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if isinstance(page, dict) and 'payment_requests' in page:
            items = page['payment_requests']
        elif isinstance(page, list):
            items = page
        else:
            items = page.get('success') if isinstance(page, dict) else []
        if not items:
            break
        results.extend(items)
        page_index += 1
    return results
